## 🎭 Signup for Playhouse Shorts

Duke Players is the student-run producing arm of the Department of Theater Studies. The group will present a weekend of Playhouse Shorts October 3 - 4. If you want to participate as writer, director, actor, or techie, sign-up this week:

- **Wednesday September 23**: [submit a play](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeeNuhE_tUC127aURpa_3qVhmPVAQeuzox4BbObmDlTBTcwmw/viewform?utm_source=chatgpt.com);
- **Friday  September 25**: [apply to act, direct, or tech](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSewNv8e5vLy3w7lOPhkVL6XC2qD8JODS4qtXhrTD4f7dt6R7A/viewform?utm_source=chatgpt.com).
